name: ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition
description: The ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition is a robotics benchmark for grasp pose selection in in-air cloth unfolding. Competing methods are evaluated on real-world cloth manipulation trials using a shared dataset and head-to-head competition setup.
evaluation_method: Success-rate based evaluation, often combined with coverage / unfolding quality measures and task completion statistics over real-world trials.
notes: Built from a publicly released dataset of real cloth unfolding attempts, later expanded with 176 competition evaluation trials for a total of 679 demonstrations across 34 garments.
